description: This file defines the 'ExecApprovalCommandDisplaySanitizer' enum which provides static methods to sanitize text by escaping invisible or format characters in Unicode strings.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes input text by escaping invisible or format characters.

methods.name: shouldEscape
methods.description: Determines if a Unicode scalar should be escaped based on its category or if it is in the set of invisible code points.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Converts a Unicode scalar into its escaped Unicode string representation.
